subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw expose current-session reset authority to after-compaction plugin hooks, and should generic terminal-overflow reset plus live tool-failure abort policy ship in the same change?
rationale: This creates a plugin-facing session lifecycle capability and changes default unattended-run termination behavior; correctness tests cannot determine the intended permanent API, trust boundary, or whether the unrelated loop policy belongs in this PR.

options.title: Narrow and split
options.body: Approve the current-session deferred hook API in principle, fix its lifecycle blockers, and move generic overflow reset and live failure-loop policy to separate reviewable work.

options.title: Approve combined policy
options.body: Keep the combined branch only after owners explicitly approve all reset and abort defaults and exact-head proof covers replies, cron, native harnesses, and gateway compaction.

options.title: Pause the API
options.body: Withhold the plugin reset capability until a smaller owner-designed session lifecycle contract and compatibility plan are available.

recommendation.title: Narrow and split
recommendation.body: Approve the current-session deferred hook API in principle, fix its lifecycle blockers, and move generic overflow reset and live failure-loop policy to separate reviewable work.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to the intersecting agent, session, Gateway, and cron ownership surfaces.
